### Other information:

#### Summary
Adds unit test coverage for `Neo.form.field.Range` in `test/playwright/unit/form/field/Range.spec.mjs` following the setup pattern in `test/playwright/unit/form/field/InputWidth.spec.mjs`.

#### Changes
- **`test/playwright/unit/form/field/Range.spec.mjs`**:
  - Installs and cleans up the `Neo.main.DomEvents` stub in `test.beforeAll` / `test.afterAll` when missing to avoid namespace collisions across the unit suite.
  - Adds 5 unit tests covering each row of the specification table:
    1. Initial label text (`'[40] Volume'`) with `showResultInLabel: true`.
    2. Reactive label text update (`'[60] Volume'`) when `value` changes.
    3. Default label text (`'Volume'`) when `showResultInLabel` is not set.
    4. Input VDOM node `type: 'range'` and `cls: ['neo-rangefield-input']`.
    5. Default configs `clearable: false` and `useSpinButtons: false`.

#### Testing
- Executed `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/form/field/Range.spec.mjs` (5 passed).
- Executed `npm run test-unit` suite without namespace collisions.
